what_this_is: D2 CP2 — the canonical address book. Every value is derived from a declaration that already exists in this repo; none is typed here. CP1 shipped it inert; CP2 adds the first non-screener store (bars_sqlite, derived from its own CREATE TABLE) and exactly ONE product reader, api/services/canonical/address_book.py, which is named by the rail that used to require zero readers. An owner-delegated extension (2026-09-23) adds breadth_snapshot_numeric (A11's breadth/exposure metrics), derived from breadth_metrics.py's own catalogue, not typed here. See PRD-D2-CANONICAL-DATA-MODEL and SPEC-D2-CANONICAL-DATA-MODEL.

sources: api/services/bars_sqlite.py :: the ohlcv CREATE TABLE literal
metric.note: a bars or breadth metric is table-qualified (ohlcv.c, breadth_snapshot_numeric.pct_above_50sma) so a short column/key name cannot shadow a screener scalar

entity.canonical_key: entity id (S3 Entity Master); a ticker is an ALIAS

timeframe.canonical_key: the bars-store CODE (e.g. 'D'), not the product label ('1D')

provider.note: optional in an address; its ABSENCE means 'the value we hold'

earnings_table.why_no_flat_metrics: unlike ohlcv, one snapshot is TWO LISTS OF ROWS (annual, quarterly), each with its own per-row shape and no single as-of column across the whole payload -- flat metric.column entries the way ohlcv.c is declared would misrepresent this shape rather than address it. Migrating a reader onto a per-field address is a separate, future checkpoint; this record only makes the shape checkable.

breadth_snapshot_numeric.column_is: a JSON key inside the `metrics` TEXT blob, not a SQL column -- this store declares no row_projection, so row_position() correctly returns None for every metric here

above_50sma.sentence: whether the price is above its 50-day average

adr_pct_1w.sentence: the average daily range over the last 5 bars, as a percent of price

atr_ext_sma50.sentence: the extension above the 50-bar average, measured in ATRs

avg_body.sentence: the average candle body, open to close, in price rather than percent, over the 15 completed sessions before the newest bar

avg_body_pct_5.sentence: the 5-bar body tightness, the average candle body as a percent of its range

avg_range.sentence: the average bar range, high minus low, in price rather than percent, over the 20 completed sessions before the newest bar

base_relation_count.sentence: the number of NAMED multi-week structures on this symbol beyond its trend shape -- a Darvas box, a Green Line Breakout, a Pocket Pivot, a Power Play. 0 means we looked and none fired

blended_growth.sentence: the blended earnings and revenue growth

body_pct.sentence: the candle body as a percentage of its range

candle_recent_bars_ago.sentence: the number of sessions since the most recent multi-bar candle pattern completed, 0 on the newest bar and at most 4 (blank when none formed inside the last five sessions)

candle_score.sentence: the screener's setup score for this symbol's candle structure

chg_from_open_pct.sentence: the percentage change from this session's open

close_cv_pct.sentence: the closing-price tightness (coefficient of variation of recent closes, %)

close_position.sentence: the close's position inside the bar's range

consecutive_down.sentence: the run of consecutive down closes

consecutive_up.sentence: the run of consecutive up closes

days_to_earnings.sentence: the number of days until the next earnings report

dist_20d_high_pct.sentence: the distance from the 20-day high, in percent

dist_20d_low_pct.sentence: the distance from the 20-day low, in percent

dist_52w_high_pct.sentence: the percentage distance from the 52-week high

dist_52w_low_pct.sentence: the percentage distance from the 52-week low

dist_ath_pct.sentence: the distance from the all-time high, in percent

dollar_vol_30d.sentence: the average daily dollar volume over 30 days

downgrades_30d.sentence: the count of analyst downgrades in the last 30 days

dp_level_dist_pct.sentence: the percentage distance to the nearest signature dark-pool level

dp_notional_1d.sentence: the dark-pool block notional on the latest session

dp_notional_5d.sentence: the dark-pool block notional across the five latest sessions

dp_prints_1d.sentence: the count of dark-pool block prints on the latest session

ema_stack_intact.sentence: whether the EMA stack is intact (close above EMA10 above EMA20, both rising)

ema_touch_count.sentence: the number of the last 15 bars that touched the 20-bar EMA

eps_next_5y_growth.sentence: the analysts' estimated annual earnings-per-share growth over the next five years (a forecast, not a realised figure)

eps_past_5y_growth.sentence: the annualised earnings-per-share growth over the past five years

float_pct.sentence: the public float as a percentage of shares outstanding

float_shares.sentence: the number of shares in the public float

higher_lows_run.sentence: the run of consecutive higher lows

hvc_52w.sentence: the 52-week high-volume-close flag from the breadth universe

implied_move_pct.sentence: the options-implied move into the next report

in_uct20.sentence: whether the symbol is in the UCT 20

index_dow.sentence: whether the symbol is in the Dow 30

index_ndx.sentence: whether the symbol is in the Nasdaq 100

index_r2k.sentence: whether the symbol is in the Russell 2000

index_sp500.sentence: whether the symbol is in the S&P 500

inside_bar_run.sentence: the run of consecutive inside bars

insider_cluster_days.sentence: the number of days since the last insider cluster buy

insider_trans_pct.sentence: the net change in insider ownership over the trailing window (buying minus selling, not the ownership level)

inst_trans_pct.sentence: the net change in institutional ownership over the trailing window (buying minus selling, not the ownership level)

ipo_age_days.sentence: the number of days since the IPO

is_etf.sentence: whether the symbol is an ETF

is_leveraged.sentence: whether the symbol is a leveraged or inverse ETF

last_report_move_pct.sentence: the percentage move on the last earnings report

lower_wick_pct.sentence: the lower wick as a percentage of the range

lt_debt_to_capital.sentence: the long-term debt to total capital ratio

narrow_bar.sentence: whether the bar is unusually narrow

new_52w_high.sentence: whether the bar made a new 52-week high

new_ath.sentence: whether this bar made a new all-time high

nr7.sentence: whether the bar is the narrowest of the last seven

opt_bull_pct_1d.sentence: the bullish share of classified options premium on the latest session

opt_net_premium_1d.sentence: the net options premium on the latest session

opt_net_premium_5d.sentence: the net options premium across the five latest sessions

optionable.sentence: whether listed options trade on the stock

pattern_engine_conf.sentence: the highest active pattern-engine confidence, on the engine's 0-100 scale

pattern_engine_dir.sentence: the best active pattern's direction, encoded 1 for bullish, -1 for bearish and 0 for neutral

pattern_engine_flat_base.sentence: the pattern engine's own reading that the symbol is in a flat base (a tight horizontal consolidation on drying volume after a prior advance), which is a different answer from the older heuristic pattern tag

pattern_engine_vcp.sentence: the pattern engine's own reading that the symbol is in a volatility contraction (successively shallower pullbacks on drying volume into a pivot), which is a different answer from the older heuristic pattern tag

pattern_entry_dist_pct.sentence: the percentage distance from the last price to the best pattern's entry level

pattern_expectancy_r.sentence: the pattern's historical expectancy in R, derived from its hit rate at an assumed 2R win and 1R loss

pattern_stop_dist_pct.sentence: the percentage distance from the last price to the best pattern's stop level

pct_vs_ema20.sentence: the percentage distance from the 20-day exponential average

pct_vs_sma20.sentence: the percentage distance from the 20-day average

pct_vs_sma200.sentence: the percentage distance from the 200-day average

pct_vs_sma50.sentence: the percentage distance from the 50-day average

pole_pct.sentence: the prior run into the current base, in percent

pt_upside_pct.sentence: the percentage upside to the consensus price target

pullback_depth_pct.sentence: the depth of the current pullback

sales_past_5y_growth.sentence: the annualised sales growth over the past five years

short_float_pct.sentence: the short interest as a percentage of the float

shortable.sentence: whether the stock is available to short

tight_consolidation.sentence: whether the recent bars are tightly consolidated

upgrades_30d.sentence: the count of analyst upgrades in the last 30 days

upper_wick_pct.sentence: the upper wick as a percentage of the range

vol_ratio.sentence: the volume ratio against its own average

vol_updown_ratio.sentence: the up-day to down-day volume ratio

wide_bar.sentence: whether the bar is unusually wide
